label: Tanec · Waacking
desc: Teatrální pohled, švihy paží nad hlavou, dramatická póza, rolování trupu, freeze.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: she stands tall and fixes an intense theatrical gaze on the camera, chin lifting slowly, and holds
she whips her arms in sharp overhead circles, wrist over wrist around her shoulders, and ends with one arm extended high
she strikes a dramatic pose, one hand pressed to her chest and the other arm thrust outward, and holds
she rolls her torso fluidly while her arms trace framing patterns around her neck and face, and ends with hands at her collarbone
she snaps into a sudden freeze, head tilted and one arm pointing at the viewer, and stays frozen
